summary.intent: Evaluate and implement two outside-of-diff-range code review comments from PR #491 on cipher-box, both concerning crash-durability gaps in the FUSE mkdir replay path.
summary.outcome: Both fixes were implemented and committed to remote: inode rollback on journal failure (unix and Windows sites) and child folder seq-0 IPNS republish in replay_mkdir_entry, bringing mkdir replay to parity with the existing file replay path.

repo: InodeTable::remove already handles full cleanup (inode, name_to_ino index, parent's children entry) — usable directly as a rollback primitive without extra bookkeeping.
The inode table is ephemeral and rebuilt from IPNS on remount, so a ghost inode from a failed journal write is transient (in-session inconsistency, not data loss), but still worth fixing.

replay_upload_entry was already hardened with first-publish detection + TEE enrollment (Steps #19/#20/F3), but replay_mkdir_entry had no equivalent child-IPNS publish step — a real asymmetry in the PR's own durability work.
resolve_ipns_for_replay returns IpnsResolveOutcome::{Found, NotFound, Error} and is the correct idempotency gate for all replay publish paths.
fuse_abi.rs warnings are pre-existing vendored-ABI noise unrelated to any changes.
The winfsp feature requires Windows-only deps (winfsp-sys, windows_core) and cannot fully build on macOS; CI validates the Windows path separately.

code.finding: Unix mkdir site: inode insertion and parent mutation happen before build_mkdir_journal_entry? and journal.put?, so an error on either ? leaves a ghost dir with no durable replay record. Fixed at line 532 by calling fs.inodes.remove(ino) in explicit error arms.
Windows mkdir site has the same insert-before-journal ordering issue as the unix site. Fixed at line 139 with the same rollback pattern.

replay_mkdir_entry only called fetch_merge_publish_parent — no child seq-0 IPNS publish. A crash after journal.put but before background thread published child IPNS left the parent pointing at an unresolvable child IPNS name. Fixed by adding publish_child_folder_metadata helper and calling it before the parent merge, with idempotency via resolve_ipns_for_replay.

workflow: Check for all callers of a function before changing its signature to avoid missed call sites.
Use cargo check + clippy on the specific crate and feature flag before committing, not just rust-analyzer (whose diagnostics can be stale).
Run replay-specific unit tests in isolation to confirm targeted fixes don't regress existing replay logic.

friction: rust-analyzer diagnostics were stale after the call-site edit, requiring a separate fresh cargo check to confirm compilation.
winfsp feature cannot be fully type-checked on macOS, leaving the Windows-platform fix partially unverifiable locally.
open_items: resolve_ipns_for_replay has a cache-fallback behavior that is a known deferred TODO (fuse-replay-ipns-strict-resolve-path-no-cache-fallback.md); the new child-folder publish call site in replay_mkdir_entry inherits this issue and will be covered when that strict-resolve fix lands.
Two original deferred TODOs from commit a84fdf4 (cache-fallback resolve and empty-FilePointer handling) are still open and were not addressed in this session.
